text.body:
tadanu niṣpāditavihārādeḥ pratiṣṭhārtham abhiṣekārthaṃ vādhyeṣitaḥ svasyānyasya vā siddhisādhanādyarthitayā mahāntaṃ sattvārthaṃ paśyan paraṃ samādāpyāpi maṇḍalalikhanāya sambhārajananīṃ pūrvasevāṃ vighnavināśinīm [\L30] ārabhet |
% de nas gtsug lag {60a1} || khang la sogs pa rdzogs pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i don dam dbang bskur ba'i don du gsol pa btab pas sam | rang dam gzhan gyi dngos grub bsgrub pa la sogs pa don du gnyer bas sam | sems can gyi don chen po mthong bas sam |
gzhan gyis bskul bas {60a2} kyang rung ste dkyil 'khor bri ba'i phyir dang tshogs bsag pa'i phyir dang | bgegs nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang | bdud gzhom par bya ba'i phyir sngon du bsnyen pa bya'o ||
yadi sarvajñamārgajño na hi siddhir asevayā |
tasmān niṣadya nirdvandvaṃ satkramadvayatattvavit ||
bhāvayed devatācakraṃ khinnas tanmantram ājapet |
cakreśasya japel lakṣaṃ lakṣaṃ vā svādhidaivatam |
cakriṇām ayutaṃ ceti pūrvaseveyam ucyate ||
% gal te kun mkhyen lam shes ni || bsnyen pa med na 'grub pa mi 'gyur || de phyir gnyis med gnas nas ni || rim {60a3} gnyis de nyid rig pa yis || lha yi 'khor lo yang dag bsgom || skyon de yi gsang sngags bzlas || 'khor lo'i gtso bo 'bum bzlas shing || yang na rang gi lha yi 'bum || dkyil 'khor ba yi khri nyid de ||
'di ni sngon du bsnyen par brjod ||
evaṃ trisamādhikuśalo yogī yathāmaṇḍalānusāreṇa pūrvasevāṃ daśāṃśena homaṃ ca kuryāt ||
% de ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum la mkhas pa'i {60a4} rnal 'byor pas ji lta bar dkyil 'khor dang rjes su mthun pa'i sngon du bsnyen pa'i bcu'i cha shas kyi sbyin sreg kyang bya'o
iti pūrvasevāniyamaprayojanavidhiḥ || ||
% zhes pa sngon du bsnyen pa'i nges pa dang dgos pa'i cho ga'o || ||
